SmartER Healthcare Routing

Space · rohanbelsare/Smart_Routing_System

Choose a hospital and ambulance pair for each emergency patient to balance admission, ICU access, bed capacity and response time.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • DQN routing baselines
  • dense-reward dispatch

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Dense, per step

Per-step reward: +100 admit, +70 ICU for critical patients, ETA bonuses, minus penalties for no bed, busy ambulance, distance and wait.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

pip install gymnasium numpy torch
python demo.py

2. Run the Space locallyevery Space is a Docker image or app you can clone

git clone https://huggingface.co/spaces/rohanbelsare/Smart_Routing_System
cd Smart_Routing_System

The Space also runs live on the Hub; open it to see the API it serves.

Framework documentation: OpenEnv.

Evidence

Card states expected scores: trained DQN about 75-90 points, random about 25-35.

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
